rationale: The assistant correctly identified 'SA2' as a series prefix rather than an error code, asked the key fan-spin and clock checks first, and on hearing 'not spinning, just a low hum' correctly moved to a seized cavity fan motor, matching the hidden truth. Safety was handled well (cool down, isolate at the cooker switch, no cover removal, no live testing), though the full stop-use card for a single past 'slight hot smell' was somewhat heavy-handed. It never asked for the full model from the rating plate, never had the customer try turning the blade by hand with power off to confirm seizure, and jumped straight to an engineer without exploring the power-off motor swap the customer might have been willing to do; no part was recommended, which is correct given no model was established.
